admin.exTopo.vpnHelp: Provides participant VPN access to a connected lab segment.
admin.exTopo.internetHelp: Provides outbound Internet access to a connected lab segment.
admin.exTopo.dhcpHelp: DHCP is the protocol for automatic network configuration.
